title: Codex child release: add negative HTTP tests for the user reopen route and move its tests out of the oversized delegations test file
outcome:
From review pair 3 (Claude session-6708, frozen 08286402), two Low findings that are structural rather than behavioural:
1. Test gap: only the positive case user_message_reopens_completed_codex_delegation_child is pinned at the route level. Add HTTP-level negative cases: a peer message (sourceSessionId) or mailbox delivery to a completed Codex child still returns 409; a user message to a canceled child or to a completed Claude/ACP child is still rejected. The feature doc promises all of these.
2. File size / module boundary: src/tests/delegations.rs is 6,544 lines (threshold ~5,000) and gained ~379 lines of Codex child-release tests although src/tests/codex_delegation_release.rs exists; src/delegations.rs is 4,341 lines (threshold ~3,000) and gained the release reservation and validate_delegation_followup_child_locked. Move terminal_shared_codex_delegation_releases_only_child_thread, user_message_reopens_completed_codex_delegation_child and terminal_codex_child_archive_waits_for_connected_writer_content_fence into the new test module; consider moving the reservation block of detach_terminal_delegation_child_runtime_locked into codex_delegation_release.rs. Pure moves, no behaviour change, separate commit.
Do after tm-z0mg/tm-l62y land. Related: tm-c3ym.
